candidates.title: HQ /ws/client accepts tokenless publishers on a password/browser-token protected bind once no live client token remains
candidates.attacker: network peer that can reach a non-loopback HQ bind, holding no credential
candidates.entry: WebSocket upgrade to /ws/client without ?token, then client.hello declaring control.receive/control.approve
trace: packages/cli/src/hq-server/upgrade-handler.ts:100 — needsAuth = hqClientAuthRequired(...)
packages/cli/src/hq-server/auth.ts:369-371 — requireAuthFloor || clientTokens.size > 0 (password/browser tokens ignored)
packages/cli/src/hq-server.ts:157 — requireAuthFloor latched only in open mode
packages/cli/src/hq-server/ws.ts:225-229 — auth.token undefined => canPublishTelemetry true => all declared capabilities accepted
packages/cli/src/hq-server/routes/command-handlers.ts — approve/answer-input/steer queued to that clientId, delivered on client.command_poll
candidates.control_analysis: The only floor is requireAuthFloor, set when HQ has NO browser credential. A credentialed HQ whose client tokens have all expired (tokenTtlMs stamps expiresAt on first-run client token) or been revoked projects to an empty set and disables /ws/client auth. auth.ts:363-368 doc says an all-expired file must not mean open registration; code does not implement that for the credentialed case.
candidates.sink: operator approval decisions, answer-input and steer text; spoofed session telemetry shown to operators
candidates.affected_principal: HQ operator and the legitimate publishers
candidates.result: source-proven that the credential check is skipped; delivery of commands requires the operator to target the rogue clientId (or lead HCM-002 takeover)
candidates.conditions: non-loopback bind; password or browser token configured; zero unexpired client tokens
candidates.next_validation: vitest beside packages/cli/tests/hq-auth-floor.test.ts: auth.json with passwordHash + one expired client token; startHqServer({port:0}); tokenless ws /ws/client + client.hello; assert 401 or hq.welcome. Owner decision: is zero-client-token OPEN MODE intended on a credentialed network bind?

candidates.title: Windows: stdio MCP servers with a bare command are launched through cmd.exe with cwd = opened project, so a repo-root npx.cmd/uvx.exe can shadow the real binary
candidates.attacker: author of a repository the user clones and opens (no config write needed)
candidates.entry: files committed at repo root named after a configured MCP command, e.g. npx.cmd, npx.bat, uvx.exe, wstack-kanban-mcp.cmd
trace: packages/cli/src/wiring/lifecycle-plugins.ts / webui-server pre-context-services.ts / acp-mcp-servers.ts — registry created with cwd = project root / ACP session cwd (5bd6b2096)
packages/core/src/infrastructure/mcp-servers.ts:22-290 — presets use bare command names (npx, uvx, wstack-*-mcp)
packages/mcp/src/client.ts:288-299 — win32: spawn(COMSPEC, ['/d','/c','call "npx" ...'], { cwd: this.opts.cwd })
packages/core/src/utils/win32-cmd.ts:38-40 — command passed to cmd `call` as a bare quoted name (no PATH resolution)
cmd.exe resolves a bare name in the CURRENT DIRECTORY before PATH (PATHEXT .COM/.EXE/.BAT/.CMD) unless NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath is set; repo-wide grep shows it is never set in buildChildEnv
candidates.control_analysis: in-project-policy.ts:70 prevents a repo from DEFINING an MCP server, and plug-lsp has a location gate (isInsideProject) for exactly this repo-binary class (WS-SEC-01), but the MCP stdio path has no equivalent: the command is never resolved to an absolute path outside the project before spawn.
candidates.sink: child process execution as the user
candidates.result: arbitrary code execution when the MCP server starts in that project, without any approval prompt
candidates.conditions: Windows; user has globally enabled at least one stdio MCP server with a bare command (presets are disabled by default); server starts (boot or first use) while the hostile repo is the project root. For the CLI the same condition existed before 5bd6b2096 because process.cwd was already the repo; the commit extends it to WebUI and ACP.
candidates.next_validation: Owner, in a scratch dir only: create dir with a harmless npx.cmd that runs `echo SHADOWED`; from Node run spawnSync(process.env.COMSPEC, ['/d','/c','call "npx" --version'], {cwd: scratch, windowsVerbatimArguments: true, encoding: 'utf8'}) and check stdout. Fix direction: resolve bare commands with plugin-sdk findOnPath and reuse plug-lsp's isInsideProject gate before spawn.
